findings.message: A fragment of a media object of stream 1 does not continue the object before it; it is dropped.
2 fragments of media objects of stream 2 do not continue the object before them; they are dropped.
A frame is invalid: coefficients run past the end of the block; a decoder drops the superframe and its bit reservoir. The first is at 0x612.
